en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said that a caller will call out on the  Day  of  Judgment,  “Where  are  oppressors  and  their helpers? Those who bring ink for them, who prepare bags for  them  and  those  who  hold  the  pen  for  them;  all  are included among their helpers.”
